audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill, Kennen, Kennen, Skill, Skill, Kennen, Kennen — Levels 4-5 and 6 marked Skill while the whys under them say you keep the poke edge and that your mark chain 'wins this pre-item all-in outright', and 2+ items marked Kennen while whys[6] says K'Sante out-scales hard.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill, Kennen, Kennen, Kennen, Kennen, Kennen, K'Sante on 331 games at 54.38% — a lane Kennen owns until K'Sante's resist stacking and All Out arrive with items.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 to Kennen and row 6 to K'Sante, as matched pairs in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike rows carried the generic template and never named a cooldown, despite the packet counting seven sequencing cues elsewhere in the file.
audit.why: The lane's spikes are Kennen's Slicing Maelstrom at 6 (flat 120s) and K'Sante's All Out (120/100/80s), which heals him and transforms his kit; Path Maker is 14s at rank 1 and Footwork 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s.
audit.corrected: 120s written into the Level 6 and All Out rows, Path Maker's 14s and Footwork's 8-10s into the cooldown block, and the first-item spike re-pointed at baiting the shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three wrong mechanics. (a) whys[0], early and spikes[2] credit K'Sante with a 'percent-HP passive' that blunts magic — Dauntless Instinct does no such thing; it marks targets to take more damage on his next attack. (b) early calls W 'the Ntofo Strikes block', conflating Q with W. (c) tldr and dosFull[2] tell you to 'E-dash his Q'; Lightning Rush is not a dash.
audit.why: Riot's text: P 'marks targets to take more damage on his next Attack'; Q Ntofo Strikes is the 450-range line that pulls at 2 stacks; W Path Maker is the 600-range charge-dash that knocks back and stuns and deals true damage; Kennen's E has no dash flag.
audit.corrected: The invented passive removed in all three places and replaced with what actually matters — Path Maker's true damage (armour and MR do not answer it) and Footwork's shield eating your burst window. The E-dash phrasing dropped from tldr.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t prescribes anti-heal but nothing says why or when — the healing is on All Out specifically.
audit.why: All Out grants 'increased damage, healing, and transformed abilities'. Grievous Wounds before you contest it, not after.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[1].d as the reason to hold Oblivion Orb before the ult fight.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dauntless Instinct's attack reset is never mentioned, and neither is Footwork's shield.
audit.why: His abilities mark you and the follow-up attack is the payload, so the attack wind-up is the tell; Footwork is a 8-10s dash-plus-shield that absorbs the burst you were counting on.
audit.corrected: Footwork added to the cooldown block and to spikes[2].text as the thing to bait before committing.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins every melee matchup early. Identify how K'Sante contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: You are both fragile at level 1 and Ntofo Strikes only reaches 450 — last-hit from 950 range and commit to nothing.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around All Out's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: You hold the poke edge, but Path Maker is a 600-range dash that stuns and deals true damage — never stand in melee for it.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom + Zhonya wins any grouped fight top-side. Reassess every all-in at 6 — K'Sante's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom plus an E-in stun-locks him before All Out can isolate you — your hardest all-in of the lane, on a flat 120s.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. K'Sante carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: All Out strips his own resists, dashes onto you and isolates you — a duel your body loses. Group and peel instead.

edits.before: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — His duelist mode. Poke when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — 120s at rank 1, and it heals him; hold Oblivion Orb before you contest it. - Path Maker: 14s, true damage, so armour and MR do not answer it. - Footwork: an 8-10s shield — bait it first.

edits.before: His duelist mode. Poke when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A 120-second duelist mode that also heals him. Engage while it is down.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: All Out heals him — get Grievous Wounds before you fight it.

edits.before: Poke his early — E-dash his Q, avoid his R form. Kennen wins the All Out cooldown windows.
edits.after: Poke him from 950, bait his Footwork shield, and burst before All Out comes online.

edits.before: You're both fragile at level 1, but his percent-HP passive blunts your single Q — last-hit at Q range and don't commit.
edits.after: You're both fragile at level 1, but Ntofo Strikes reaches only 450 on a 3.5s cooldown — last-hit from 950 and don't commit.

edits.before: You keep the poke edge but respect his level-3 W-dash Q-knockup combo — chip and don't stand in melee.
edits.after: You keep the poke edge, but Path Maker is a 600-range dash that stuns for true damage — never stand in melee.

edits.before: Hextech Alternator / Liandry's cashes your R combo into real kill pressure — his percent-HP passive doesn't save him from full burst.
edits.after: Hextech Alternator / Liandry's cashes your R combo into real kill pressure — but Footwork shields him on an 8-10 second cooldown, so bait it first.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — one Q and your Electrical Surge autos chip, but you're squishy and he has a percent-HP passive that softens your magic, so don't overcommit. The real opener is levels 2-3: a second Q point plus W on-hit lets you build Mark of the Storm and land hard poke while his W (the Ntofo Strikes block / dash) is on cooldown. Bait his W block — once it's down, your Q poke and mark stack land clean. Don't auto into his W ready or he'll block the mark and dash on you.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — one Q and your Electrical Surge autos chip, but you're squishy and Ntofo Strikes slows you at 450 range every 3.5 seconds, so don't overcommit. The real opener is levels 2-3: a second Q point plus W on-hit lets you build Mark of the Storm and land hard poke while Path Maker, his 14-second charge-dash, is down. Bait it — it stuns and the damage is true, so armour and MR are no answer. Never stand in melee with Path Maker up.
